items.t: Scope: the SnapStats community "Langley" combines the Township and the City across eleven sub-areas (Aldergrove, Brookswood, Campbell Valley, County Line Glen Valley, Fort Langley, Langley City, Murrayville, Otter District, Salmon River, Walnut Grove, Willoughby Heights). Street-level board boundaries for the sub-areas are not verified — FVREB publishes no street-level sub-area boundaries in public form, and no municipal boundaries were substituted.

Attached context (this feed is detached-only): Condos & Townhomes combined 699 / 128 / median $611,000, $513/sq ft, 97%, 25 days — combined figures, NOT condo-only; the Langley community figure combines City + Township, as stated above. SnapStats publishes medians at community level only — per-sub-area medians are not verified.

Detached supply shape: inventory led by Willoughby Heights (100) and Brookswood (98), then Langley City (64) and Aldergrove (55), while detached sales concentrated in Walnut Grove (13) and Willoughby Heights (13); Walnut Grove's 30% detached sales ratio was the highest in Langley in September 2026, ahead of Salmon River 23% and Murrayville 17%.
The exact feed filter criteria are not verified.
Schools: both municipalities are in SD35 Langley; catchments are address-based.

Transit / health: TransLink states the Province is delivering a 16-kilometre Expo Line extension along Fraser Highway from King George Station to 203 Street in Langley City, anticipated in-service 2029; current bus route numbers/frequencies are not verified pass. Langley Memorial Hospital, 22051 Fraser Highway, is the Fraser Health community hospital for the Langleys.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Langley Houses for Sale

items.t: Municipal frame for houses (this page's core rules): Township SSMUH Bylaw No. 6020, adopted November 18, 2024 — an eligible lot (inside the Urban Containment Boundary, on both municipal water and sewer, not heritage-designated, not in a Transit-Oriented Area) may have 3 units if 280 m² or smaller, or 4 units if between 280 m² and 4,050 m²; lots larger than 4,050 m² are not eligible; there is NO 6-unit tier in the Township. City SSMUH Bylaw No. 3284, adopted June 17, 2024 — RS1/RS2 lots permit 4 units, or 6 if within 400 m of a frequent bus stop. City suites under Zoning Bylaw 2025 No. 3300 (cite the number; adoption date not verified, conflicted in sources): the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of gross floor area, registered owner must reside on the lot (s.2.4); carriage/garden ground-floor unit capped at 100 m².

Willoughby plan frame (Township context): the Willoughby Community Plan was Bylaw 1836 (1979) and is now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025); the Willoughby Plan Update Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 had first/second reading May 25, 2026 ONLY — never describe them as adopted.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Langley Houses for Sale

items.t: Township frame (Township ground ONLY): Zoning Bylaw 2500. SSMUH Bylaw 6020, adopted November 18, 2024 — an eligible lot (Urban Containment Boundary, municipal water AND sewer, not heritage-designated, not in a Transit-Oriented Area) may have 3 units if 280 m² or smaller, or 4 units if between 280 m² and 4,050 m² (1 acre); lots larger than 4,050 m² are not eligible. There is NO 6-unit tier in the Township. Secondary suites: s.102 caps a suite at 120 m², one per principal dwelling unit. Coach house = fee-simple second unit under s.102 (accessory unit only within the second storey of a detached garage), never strata. Live conflict, flagged not resolved: s.102 as amended July 21, 2025 (Bylaw 6147) lists suite locations including within a townhouse/rowhouse, while the Township's January 2025 Secondary Suites guide position differs — both documents stand by date.
Township R-CL: s.403 = 220 m² minimum LOT area / 464.5 m² maximum LOT area. The "355 m²" figure is NOWHERE in the bylaw. (Standing correction.)

Township subdivision/servicing: Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw 2019 No. 5382 — CONFIRMED as the servicing bylaw for Township subdivision. Per-lot servicing costs not confirmed, none stated.

Township / Willoughby plan frame: Willoughby Community Plan = Bylaw 1836 (1979), now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025). Willoughby Plan Update Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 = first/second reading May 25, 2026 ONLY, Public Hearing directed June 15, 2026 — never present as repeals/adoptions done. (Standing corrections.)

City frame (City ground ONLY): Zoning Bylaw 2025 No. 3300, cited by number — adoption date not verified. SSMUH Bylaw 3284, adopted June 17, 2024: RS1/RS2 lots permit 4 units, or 6 if within 400 m of a frequent bus stop. Suites: lesser of 100 m² and 40% of gross floor area; registered owner must reside on the lot (s.2.4); carriage/garden ground-floor unit capped at 100 m².

ALR block (where ALR ground is confirmed per parcel): subdivision in the ALR needs ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. A flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

BC strata block (applies in full to any bare-land strata lot): Form B diligence (within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page) with depreciation report, CRF and levies; depreciation reports 5-year cycle for 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF since November 1, 2023; rental bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2, May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw.

FTHB GST rebate / programs: Bill C-4 rebate (Royal Assent March 13, 2026 per CRA; 100% to $1M, max $50,000, phasing to $1.5M; agreements March 20, 2025–2031) applies to new HOUSING, not bare land. New Housing Rebate 36% / max $6,300 / $350,000–$450,000; Home Buyers' Plan $60,000; FHSA $40,000 / $8,000 per year.

faq.q: How many units can an eligible Township lot hold?
faq.a: Under Bylaw No. 6020: 3 units for lots of 280 m² or less, 4 units for lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m²; lots over 1 acre are not eligible, eligibility also requires the Urban Containment Boundary, municipal water and sewer, no heritage designation and no Transit-Oriented Area location, and there is no 6-unit tier.

faq.q: How big can a secondary suite be?
faq.a: Township: 120 m² maximum (s.102). City: the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of the building's gross floor area, with the registered owner residing on the lot (Bylaw 3300, s.2.4). Verify against the right municipality's bylaw before marketing a suite.

faq.q: How many units can an eligible Township lot hold?
faq.a: Under Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024): 3 units for lots of 280 m² or less, and 4 units for lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m² (1 acre); lots larger than 1 acre are not eligible, and eligibility also requires the Urban Containment Boundary, municipal water and sewer, no heritage designation and no Transit-Oriented Area location.

faq.q: How big can a secondary suite be — including in a townhouse?
faq.a: Township: 120 m² maximum (Bylaw 2500 s. 102). City: the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of the building's gross floor area, with the registered owner residing on the lot (Bylaw 3300, s. 2.4).

faq.q: How many units can a Township lot hold?
faq.a: Under Bylaw 6020: 3 at 280 m² or smaller, 4 from 280 m² to 4,050 m² — eligible lots only (UCB, water + sewer, no heritage, not in a TOA). No 6-unit tier exists in the Township.

faq.q: How many units can a City lot hold?
faq.a: Under Bylaw 3284: RS1/RS2 lots 4 units, or 6 within 400 m of a frequent bus stop — a different answer from the Township's, which is why the municipality check comes first.

faq.q: What did Langley detached homes sell for in September 2026?
faq.a: Per-sub-area medians are not published: Not verified. (SnapStats, September 2026)

faq.q: Is the unit-numbered Murrayville card a bare-land strata house?
faq.a: Not verified — its form cannot be settled from the card text. Confirm on title before treating it either way.

faq.q: How many units can an eligible Township of Langley lot hold?
faq.a: Under Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024): 3 units for lots of 280 m² or less, and 4 units for lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m² (1 acre); lots larger than 1 acre are not eligible, and eligibility also requires the Urban Containment Boundary, municipal water and sewer, no heritage designation and no Transit-Oriented Area location. There is no 6-unit tier in the Township.

faq.q: How many units can a City of Langley house lot hold?
faq.a: Under Bylaw No. 3284 (adopted June 17, 2024), RS1 and RS2 lots permit a Plex-Home of up to 4 units, or 6 units if within 400 m of a frequent bus stop — a different answer from the Township's, which is why the municipality check comes first.

faq.q: Which school district serves Langley houses, and how are catchments set?
faq.a: SD35 Langley for both municipalities; catchments are address-based. Recorded locator runs in this program exist only for 26850 29 Ave (Aldergrove), 4452 256 St (Salmon River) and 7888 200 St (Willoughby) — confirm any other address with the SD35 School Locator before relying on a school claim (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/verification/catchment-addresses-by-district.md, read 2026-11-01).
